name: 98148 · Burien, WA
findings: ZIP 98148 (Burien) has 31 nonprofit organizations. 19 of them (61%) list at least one way to get involved on their websites: membership, volunteering, public events, or civic and political action.
The most common is membership, listed by 17 organizations.
Religious organizations are the largest group offering opportunities (32% of those with an identified type).
Compared with 10 similar places, ZIP 98148 (Burien) has about as many organizations offering opportunities per resident.
